en.electronics.frame_holds: Frame {title} holds {parts}; {outside} in no frame yet.
en.electronics.frame_holds_all: Frame {title} holds {parts}; every part is in a frame now.
en.electronics.sheet_move_snapped: Moved by {dx}, {dy} mm: Move by goes in whole steps of the 2.54 mm grid, as a drag does. Hold Cmd (Ctrl) as you press Move to move by exactly what is typed.
en.electronics.sheet_move_too_small: Nothing moved: Move by goes in whole steps of the 2.54 mm grid, and that is less than half a step. Hold Cmd (Ctrl) as you press Move to move by exactly what is typed.
en.electronics.sheet_net_changed: This move disconnected {lost} from {net} and connected {gained}
en.electronics.sheet_turn_label_help: R turns it and X mirrors it before you click; the ghost shows the way it will point.
en.electronics.symbol_net_changed: This symbol change disconnected {lost} from {net} and connected {gained}

ar.electronics.count_labels_one: تسمية واحدة أو منفذ تغذية واحد

ko.electronics.frame_holds: 도면 틀 {title}에는 {parts}이(가) 있습니다. {outside}은(는) 아직 어느 도면 틀에도 없습니다.

ko.electronics.sheet_move_too_small: 아무것도 이동하지 않았습니다. 이동량은 2.54mm 그리드의 정수 단계로 움직이며, 이 값은 반 단계보다 작습니다. 입력한 값 그대로 움직이려면 이동을 누를 때 Cmd(Ctrl)를 누르고 있으세요.
ko.electronics.sheet_turn_label_help: 클릭하기 전에 R로 회전, X로 미러링합니다. 미리 보기가 향할 방향을 보여 줍니다.
